resources.string:
An enhancement of ONScripter, developed by YuriSizuku 

 1. Game Dir 
 add local / SAF / SMB sources in the settings, and enable one or more 
 SMB games are downloaded to app storage before running 

 2. Game Setting 
 setting game parameter like `strech fullscreen` 

 3. Game Gesture 
 [long click/3 fingers] to invoke menu 
 [4 fingers] to skip text 

 4. Gamepad 
 custom button mapping in the settings 

 5. SMB 
 SMB2/SMB3 client: SMBJ (github.com/hierynomus/smbj), Apache License 2.0
